newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields edge down.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields edge down.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month, nine-month, 12-month and 18-month treasury bills edged down from the last sales, the central bank said on Tuesday.

Six-month bills slipped to 20.17 percent from 20.20 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 27.73 percent from 27.75 percent, 12-month bills edged down to 30.04 percent from 30.34 percent and 18-month bills eased to 32.53 percent from 32.54 percent.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated 45.00 million UAH
Amount sold 6.06 million UAH 33.03 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.50 million UAH 30.01 million UAH
The central bank sold 60,558 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 17.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 27.30 million UAH 40.00 million UAH
Amount sold 14.61 million UAH 25.04 million UAH
Actual amount raised 12.10 million UAH 20.74 million UAH
The central bank sold 146,067 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 17.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 87.13 million UAH 105.69 million UAH
Actual amount raised 67.05 million UAH 81.13 million UAH
The central bank sold 871,298 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 17.
The results of the 18-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 14.08 million UAH 31.51 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.47 million UAH 21.19 million UAH
The central bank sold 140,774 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 18-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 17.
